integrity: Mathematical proof and exact symbolic checker included. Checker tests algebraic identities and examples; it is not an infinite-time proof or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for the explicitly defined three-harmonic phase-reduced ODE with positive weights and symmetric pair coupling, not for any underlying delayed neuronal model. The six configurations are canonical, not an exhaustive list of all attractors. Critical-time asymptotics apply on the invariant two-cluster manifold. Historical priority is provisional, and independent validation has not been undertaken.
title: Six canonical attracting rhythms and a critical algebraic clock in a three-harmonic phase triad
